engine: Connected PostgreSQL; separate transactions under authenticated role
session_model: Temporary database fixtures with session claims, no passwords, JWTs, refresh tokens, emails or invitations

scenarios.test: original cast racing delegate replacement; replacement retries
accepted transaction rolled back, then retried

limitations: Database role/session claims are exercised directly, not an end-to-end real-user sign-in.
No Safari, TestFlight or owner-device validation.
